text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheers envelop the victor. At the center 
of that circle, <chrname> could not stand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next comes the real thing: the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe―― With what little time 
remains, still believing in victory, she 
will make <chrname> the best in the world...!
